scope: All levels receive exactly the same frozen planned shot. Engineering noise validation, not measured human ratings or full-match win rates.

config.source: Engineering execution-noise settings, not measured human skill levels. All levels use the same trained planner. Speed is cue-head speed, not cue-ball speed.
config.bounds: Angle wraps at 360 degrees. Speed uses a normal distribution conditioned on positive speed and existing cue/normal/rail limits. Rear-space restrictions can project angle error toward the original feasible direction. No outcome-based resampling.
